elements.name: SRC Store
elements.description: Conformed Store dimension referenced from the Retail Sales Activity model.

elements.name: SRC Date
elements.description: Conformed Date dimension (4-5-4 fiscal) referenced from the Retail Sales Activity model.

elements.name: SRC Sales Activity
elements.description: Sales + returns fact referenced from the Retail Sales Activity model, projected to the columns needed for hourly dollars.

elements.name: Time
elements.description: Hour-of-day dimension. Hours 9-20 are the only hours present in store traffic and labor.

columns.name: Hour
columns.description: Hour of day, 0-23. Store facts only populate 9-20.

columns.name: Daypart
columns.description: Morning / Afternoon / Evening grouping of the hour.

elements.name: Store
elements.description: 200 selling stores plus the Central Warehouse (Store Key 9999). Note the warehouse has NO labor or traffic rows, so Store Operations facts cover 200 stores only.

elements.name: Date
elements.description: Retail 4-5-4 fiscal calendar. Sigma's built-in period-over-period and DateLookback are CALENDAR-based and will not align to 4-5-4 week boundaries; use Prior Year Date for fiscal-correct comps.

elements.name: Store Leadership
elements.description: Field leadership roster: 200 Store Managers (one per store) -> 18 AVPs -> 5 RVPs. Only Store Managers carry a Store Key; AVP and RVP rows have none. Reports To Key chains upward and is null for RVPs.

elements.name: Hourly Orders
elements.description: F_SALES collapsed to Store Key x Date Key x Hour. MANDATORY pre-aggregation: joining raw F_SALES to the hourly fact would fan it out. Retail Orders isolates in-store transactions, which is the correct numerator for conversion against door traffic.

columns.name: Sale Hour
columns.description: Hour of day the order was placed, parsed from the order timestamp. Retail orders span hours 9-20, matching store labor and traffic exactly.

columns.name: Retail Orders
columns.formula: CountDistinct(If([SRC F_SALES/Channel Type] = "Retail", [SRC F_SALES/Order Number], Null))
columns.description: In-store orders only. Web, BOPIS and BOSS orders are credited to a store but did not walk through its door, so they must be excluded from conversion.

elements.name: Hourly Sales
elements.description: Sales Activity collapsed to Store Key x Sale Date x Hour, dated by SALE Timestamp so returns net back against the hour that originally sold the item. MANDATORY pre-aggregation before joining to the hourly fact.

columns.name: Gross Sales
columns.formula: Sum(If([SRC Sales Activity/Activity Type] = "Sale", [SRC Sales Activity/Amount], 0))

columns.name: Retail Net Sales
columns.formula: Sum(If([SRC Sales Activity/Channel Type] = "Retail", [SRC Sales Activity/Amount], 0))
columns.description: In-store sales only. This is the correct numerator for any ratio measured against door traffic.

columns.name: Retail Net Cost
columns.formula: Sum(If([SRC Sales Activity/Channel Type] = "Retail", [SRC Sales Activity/Cost], 0))

columns.name: Retail Net Units
columns.formula: Sum(If([SRC Sales Activity/Channel Type] = "Retail", [SRC Sales Activity/Quantity], 0))

elements.name: Store Hour
elements.description: One row per Store x Date x Hour (3,332,953). Store traffic and labor are exactly co-grained and join 1:1; orders and dollars are LEFT JOINed from pre-aggregated elements. Covers 200 selling stores - the Central Warehouse (9999) has no labor or traffic. Labor carries STAFF COUNTS, not hours, so 'per staffed hour' means per staffed store-hour. Dollar ratios use Retail Net Sales (in-store only) because they are measured against door traffic; the all-channel columns are partial by design and must not be divided by traffic. All ratios are metrics so they recompute correctly at every rollup.

columns.name: Store Visits
columns.description: Door counter traffic for this store-hour.

columns.name: Scheduled Staff Count
columns.description: Headcount the schedule called for. NOT hours.

columns.name: Actual Staff Count
columns.description: Headcount actually on the floor. NOT hours.

columns.name: Staffing Variance
columns.formula: [SRC F_LABOR/Actual Staff Count] - [SRC F_LABOR/Scheduled Staff Count]
columns.description: Actual minus scheduled headcount. Scheduled and actual net out almost exactly company-wide, so only per-store-hour variance carries signal.

columns.name: Orders
columns.description: All orders credited to this store in this hour, every channel.

columns.name: Retail Orders
columns.description: In-store orders only - the correct numerator for conversion against door traffic.

columns.name: Retail Net Sales
columns.description: In-store sales net of returns, dated by the hour of the original sale. COMPLETE: every in-store order falls inside a staffed store-hour. Use this for all traffic-based ratios.

columns.name: Retail Gross Margin
columns.formula: [Hourly Sales/Retail Net Sales] - [Hourly Sales/Retail Net Cost]

columns.name: Net Sales (All Channels, In-Hours)
columns.description: All-channel sales credited to this store that transacted during a staffed store-hour. PARTIAL BY DESIGN: digital orders placed outside trading hours have no store-hour to land on, so this runs about 9% below company net sales. Never use it as a company sales total - use the Retail Sales Activity model for that - and never divide it by door traffic.

columns.name: Is Open Hour
columns.formula: If([Date/Day of Week Name] = "Sunday", [SRC F_STORE_TRAFFIC/Hour] >= [Store/Sunday Open Hour] and [SRC F_STORE_TRAFFIC/Hour] < [Store/Sunday Close Hour], [SRC F_STORE_TRAFFIC/Hour] >= [Store/Weekday Open Hour] and [SRC F_STORE_TRAFFIC/Hour] < [Store/Weekday Close Hour])
columns.description: True when the store was trading this hour, per its weekday/Sunday opening hours. Currently TRUE for every row: traffic and labor are only recorded for hours a store actually trades, so the shoulder hours simply have fewer store-hours rather than closed rows. Retained as a guard in case closed-hour rows are ever loaded.

elements.name: Store Day
elements.description: Store Hour rolled up to one row per Store x Date (365,400 potential store-days). Use this for trend and period reporting so dashboards do not scan 3.3M hourly rows. Same metric definitions as Store Hour.

columns.name: Open Hours
columns.description: Number of trading hours this store-day.

elements.name: Budget
elements.description: Sales plan per store per fiscal period. COARSER grain than Store Day - join on Store Key + Fiscal Year + Fiscal Period, never on date.
